hook_vo: Friends' money gifts above fifty thousand rupees a year: all of it taxable.

cards.name: Limit
cards.text: in a tax year, in total. Above it, the whole sum is taxable.
cards.sub: New Income-tax Act, 2025. Year 2026-27. A gifted TV is not counted.
cards.vo: The limit counts a whole tax year's money gifts from non-relatives.

cards.name: Example
cards.text: two gifts, all of it taxable
cards.vo: Two gifts of twenty-five and twenty-eight thousand: all fifty-three thousand is taxable.

cards.name: Employer
cards.text: a tax year in gifts or vouchers: below it, valued at nil
cards.sub: Income-tax Rules, 2026. An older page shows ₹5,000 for gifts in kind.
cards.vo: Employer gifts under fifteen thousand rupees a year count as nil value.

cards.name: Cash
cards.text: or more in a day, or for one occasion: only through a bank
cards.sub: Cheque, draft or electronic mode. A penalty can equal the sum received.
cards.vo: Two lakh or more from one person a day: bank only.

so.vo: Relatives' gifts and your own wedding gifts: not taxed. Diwali: no exemption.
so.note: 'Relative' is a list defined in the Act. The department's rules, not advice on anyone's tax.

end.vo: Did you know the fifty thousand rupee rule? Comment below.
